facts.text: The user asked which traditional game played during powwows is the most exciting to watch.
The assistant said that Stick Game is a traditional game played during Native American powwows using stick markers and a bowl, and players guess the location of the marked stick.
The assistant said that Hand Games are a traditional gambling game played during Native American powwows by two teams that guess which hand is hiding a bone or stick.
The assistant said that Drum and Dance Competitions are a popular feature of powwows, with drum groups competing for the best rhythm and dancers competing based on style and skill.
The user asked for recommendations for the best powwows to attend.
The user definitely wants to attend a powwow.

The assistant said that Indian Relay is a fast-paced horse racing event at powwows that involves multiple riders and horse exchanges, and the goal is to complete a circuit around the track in the shortest time possible.
The user has always been interested in Native American culture.
